card.name: Inside interleukin and other split words
card.fires_on: The final piece of "interleukin" just before a hyphen and number (as in interleukin-2 or -6). It also fires on odd mid-word pieces, such as Lao script letters, "Tuscany" and "anecdotally".

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The "in" that ends "interleuk" before a hyphen and a number or an abbreviation.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Pieces partway through rare words or Lao script, where the word is not yet finished.
modes.example: In 1559 the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med

card.writes: It adds little that is clear, mostly odd word-piece tokens, and it lowers common small words such as "is", "to" and "in".
card.plain: It lights up on the last letters of the word interleukin, and occasionally in the middle of other rare words.
